event.title: Q4 2025 program reporting - BildungsBruecke e.V., Koeln

reports.text: Q4 in Koeln was a success. We trained roughly thirty young people in the digital basics course and most of them completed it. Very engaged group.

Attendance record, Youth Digital Skills, Koeln, Q4 2025. Five sessions held (S1-S5). Unique participants across the quarter: 27. Per-session present counts: S1=25, S2=24, S3=20, S4=22, S5=19. Source: signed session sheets.
For the Q4 write-up: report participation as 'attended'. Completion requires the end-of-program assessment (ASSESS form). ASSESS results for Koeln Q4 have been received: 21 participants passed.
Tranche 3 disbursement to BildungsBruecke e.V. is pending the approved Q4 narrative report.
